item.description: • Fixed a real bug: every release since v1.0.0 shipped Apple-Silicon-only despite the downloads page always claiming a universal build. xcodebuild's plain build command was silently constraining to the host architecture regardless of the ARCHS setting -- switched the release process to xcodebuild archive, which respects it correctly. This is the first genuinely universal (Intel + Apple Silicon) build.

• Fixed Chat mode: it never actually worked before (10s timeout vs ~28s real model latency meant every message silently fell back to the click-through flow). Now uses gemma3:4b (3-5s/turn), verified live in English and Spanish.
  • Fixed native controls (DisclosureGroup, Picker) showing the Mac's system accent color instead of Automality teal.
  • Added Sparkle auto-update -- this is the first version that can update itself.
